summary: Iteration 38: Tested 6 major features - Estimates CRUD, Unified Tickets with type filters, Ticket Worksheets, Job Numbering Settings, Splynx Non-Payment UI, Workshop/Field Job detail views. Backend 28/28 tests passed (100%). Frontend UI all tested features working correctly.
passed_tests: === Backend API Tests (28/28 passed) ===
GET /api/estimates - returns list of estimates
GET /api/estimates/stats/summary - returns total, by_status, total_value, approved_value
POST /api/estimates - creates estimate with line items, tax calculation (subtotal/tax/total verified)
GET /api/estimates/{id} - returns single estimate with all fields
PUT /api/estimates/{id}/status - status changes: draft -> published (verified published_at)
PUT /api/estimates/{id}/status - status changes: published -> sent (verified sent_at)
PUT /api/estimates/{id}/status - status changes: sent -> approved (verified approved_at)
GET /api/estimates/{id}/audit-log - returns audit trail with actions (created, status changes)
POST /api/estimates/{id}/convert-to-invoice - converts to invoice, status becomes 'converted'
DELETE /api/estimates/{id} - deletes estimate and returns 404 on subsequent GET
GET /api/tickets/{id}/worksheet - returns worksheet items (empty array if none)
POST /api/tickets/{id}/worksheet - adds new worksheet item with added_by/added_at
POST /api/tickets/{id}/worksheet/check - checks item with checked_by_name and checked_at audit trail
POST /api/tickets/{id}/worksheet/check - unchecks item successfully
GET /api/worksheet-templates - returns SLA/Workshop/Cabling templates
GET /api/settings/job-numbering - returns current prefix configuration
PUT /api/settings/job-numbering - saves SLA, Workshop, Cabling prefixes
GET /api/splynx/overview - returns ISP health overview (MOCKED)
GET /api/splynx/non-payment - returns non-payment tracker data (MOCKED)
GET /api/tickets - returns 26 SLA tickets
GET /api/workshop/jobs - returns 1 workshop job (WS-1001)
GET /api/workshop/stats - returns workshop statistics
GET /api/field-jobs - returns 1 field job (FJ-1001)
GET /api/field-jobs/stats/summary - returns field job statistics
GET /api/ - API health check returns operational status
GET /api/clients - returns client list
GET /api/invoices - returns invoice list

context_for_next_testing_agent: Iteration 38 verified all 6 major features working: 1) Estimates module fully functional - CRUD, status lifecycle (draft->published->sent->approved), convert to invoice, audit trail, stats 2) Unified Tickets with type filter buttons (All/SLA/Workshop/Cabling-WISP) with correct icons (Shield/Wrench/Wifi) and counts 3) Ticket Worksheets with auditable checklist - add items, check/uncheck with user/timestamp trail 4) Job Numbering Settings card with prefix fields (SLA-/WS-/CW-) 5) Splynx Non-Payment tab with overdue customer tracker 6) Workshop and Field Job detail views render from unified list. Existing data: EST-1001 ($1650), 26 SLA tickets, WS-1001 workshop job, FJ-1001 field job.

estimates_module.details: Full CRUD + lifecycle. Create with line items and tax calculation. Status progression: draft -> published -> sent -> approved -> converted. Convert to invoice creates INV with estimate data. Audit trail tracks all actions. Stats show total, by_status, total_value, approved_value.

unified_tickets.details: Type filter buttons show All (28), SLA (26), Workshop (1), Cabling/WISP (1). Correct icons: Shield for SLA (blue), Wrench for Workshop (purple), Wifi for Cabling (cyan). Clicking filter shows filtered list. Header shows 'Tickets & Jobs' with count subtitle.

ticket_worksheets.details: Worksheets tab in ticket detail shows count. Input field to add checklist items. Items stored with added_by and added_at. Check/uncheck items updates checked_by_name and checked_at. Counter shows x/y completed.

job_numbering_settings.details: Card at bottom of Settings page. Three input fields for SLA Prefix, Workshop Prefix, Cabling/WISP Prefix. Shows example format (e.g. SLA-00001). Save Prefixes button saves to API.

splynx_non_payment.details: Non-Payment tab in ISP Service Health page. Stats cards: Total Overdue, Overdue Customers, Suspended, Auto-Suspend toggle. Table for overdue customers with columns. Info box explains grace period (14 days).

workshop_detail_view.details: WS-1001 visible in Workshop filter. Wrench icon, purple border, WORKSHOP badge. Click opens detail view with customer info, device details, parts used section, labour timer, billing summary, status update buttons.

field_job_detail_view.details: FJ-1001 visible in Cabling/WISP filter. Wifi icon, cyan border, zone badge, address. Click opens detail with Installation Checklist (6 items), Signal & Speed Test inputs, Update Status buttons (En Route/On Site/Completed/Cancelled).
